run_warc_reader_fast: run the WarcReaderFast pipeline step to read WARc archive records from a data folder using threaded workers
read_media_record_warc: read a single WARc media record by seeking to the correct offset and returning the content stream bytes
create_warc_reader_threaded: create a WarcReaderFast instance with a data folder, worker count, and optional order preservation flag
reuse_thread_local_file_pointer: reuse thread-local file pointers across multiple WARc reads to avoid repeated file open/close overhead
test_warc_reader_fast: test the WarcReaderFast class by passing Media objects with valid path and offset fields
